steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Add one line item for the vendor to quote.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event is valid.
Save a schedule starting now with a 30-minute duration.
Invite the vendor who must bid immediately.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Open the buyer's events list to inspect the published status.
Verify the event is shown as Live to the buyer.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event's pricing round where the bid cells should be available.
Verify the vendor's immediate bid was submitted successfully.
